```python import re import json import pytest from youtube_dl.extractor.nrk import NRKTVEpisodeIE, NRKIE, NRKTVIE class DummyNRKTVEpisodeIE(NRKTVEpisodeIE): """Subclass that overrides network calls for deterministic testing.""" def __init__(self, webpage, json_ld=None, meta_id=None): super().__init__() self._dummy_webpage = webpage self._dummy_json_ld = json_ld self._dummy_meta_id = meta_id def _download_webpage(self, url, display_id, note=None, errnote=None, *, data=None, headers=None, timeout=None, err=None): return self._dummy_webpage def _search_json_ld(self, webpage, display_id, default=None): if self._dummy_json_ld is not None: return self._dummy_json_ld return default def _html_search_meta(self, name, webpage, default=None): if self._dummy_meta_id is not None: return self._dummy_meta_id return default def _search_regex(self, pattern, string, name, default=None): # Fallback to regex search if needed m = re.search(pattern, string) return m.group(1) if m else default def test_extract_with_json_ld(): """Test extraction when JSON‑LD contains the NRK id.""" # Prepare a minimal webpage containing JSON‑LD with @id json_ld = { "@id": "MUHH36005220", "name": "Hellums kro - 2. Kro, krig og kjærlighet", "description": "Some description", "duration": 1563.92, "ageLimit": 6, "episode": "2. Kro, krig og kjærlighet", "series": "Hellums kro" } webpage = f'' extractor = DummyNRKTVEpisodeIE(webpage, json_ld=json_ld) info = extractor._real_extract( 'https://tv.nrk.no/serie/hellums-kro/sesong/1/episode/2') assert info['id'] == 'MUHH36005220' assert info['season_number'] == 1 assert info['episode_number'] == 2 assert info['title'] == 'Hellums kro - 2. Kro, krig og kjærlighet' assert info['age_limit'] == 6 assert info['ie_key'] == NRKIE.ie_key() assert info['url'] == 'nrk:MUHH36005220' def test_extract_with_meta_tag(): """Test extraction when JSON‑LD is missing but meta tag provides NRK id.""" # Webpage without JSON‑LD but with meta tag webpage = '' extractor = DummyNRKTVEpisodeIE(webpage, meta_id="MSUI14000816") info = extractor._real_extract( 'https://tv.nrk.no/serie/backstage/sesong/1/episode/8') assert info['id'] == 'MSUI14000816' assert info['season_number'] == 1 assert info['episode_number'] == 8 assert info['title'] == 'Backstage - 8. episode' assert info['age_limit'] == 0 assert info['url'] == 'nrk:MSUI14000816' def test_extract_fallback_regex(): """Test extraction when both JSON‑LD and meta tag are missing, fallback to regex.""" # Webpage with data-program-id attribute webpage = '
' extractor = DummyNRKTVEpisodeIE(webpage, json_ld=None, meta_id=None) # Override _search_regex pattern to match NRKTVIE._EPISODE_RE info = extractor._real_extract( 'https://tv.nrk.no/serie/hellums-kro/sesong/1/episode/2') assert info['id'] == 'MUHH36005220' assert info['season_number'] == 1 assert info['episode_number'] == 2 assert info['url'] == 'nrk:MUHH36005220' ```
